SELECT r.refund_id AS refundId, r.refund_no AS refundNo, r.order_id AS orderId, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.user_id AS userId, u.phone AS userPhone, u.nickname AS nickname, o.project_id AS projectId, p.title AS projectTitle, o.session_id AS sessionId, s.city_name AS cityName, s.station_name AS stationName, r.refund_status AS refundStatus, r.refund_type_snapshot AS refundTypeSnapshot, r.fee_rate_snapshot AS feeRateSnapshot, r.refund_amount AS refundAmount, r.fee_amount AS feeAmount, r.reason AS reason, r.fail_reason AS failReason, r.apply_time AS applyTime, r.refund_time AS refundTime, r.update_time AS updateTime FROM refund_record r LEFT JOIN ticket_order o ON o.order_id = r.order_id LEFT JOIN user_account u ON u.user_id = o.user_id LEFT JOIN performance_project p ON p.project_id = o.project_id LEFT JOIN performance_session s ON s.session_id = o.session_id
ORDER BY r.apply_time DESC, r.refund_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT r.refund_id AS refundId, r.refund_no AS refundNo, r.order_id AS orderId, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.user_id AS userId, u.phone AS userPhone, u.nickname AS nickname, o.project_id AS projectId, p.title AS projectTitle, p.poster_url AS posterUrl, o.session_id AS sessionId, s.city_name AS cityName, s.station_name AS stationName, v.venue_name AS venueName, o.order_status AS orderStatus, o.pay_amount AS orderPayAmount, r.refund_status AS refundStatus, r.refund_type_snapshot AS refundTypeSnapshot, r.fee_rate_snapshot AS feeRateSnapshot, r.refund_amount AS refundAmount, r.fee_amount AS feeAmount, r.reason AS reason, r.fail_reason AS failReason, r.apply_time AS applyTime, r.refund_time AS refundTime, r.update_time AS updateTime FROM refund_record r LEFT JOIN ticket_order o ON o.order_id = r.order_id LEFT JOIN user_account u ON u.user_id = o.user_id LEFT JOIN performance_project p ON p.project_id = o.project_id LEFT JOIN performance_session s ON s.session_id = o.session_id LEFT JOIN venue v ON v.venue_id = s.venue_id WHERE r.refund_id = #{refundId} LIMIT 1

SELECT ticket_id AS ticketId, ticket_no AS ticketNo, order_item_id AS orderItemId, order_audience_id AS orderAudienceId, ticket_status AS ticketStatus, qr_code_value AS qrCodeValue, seat_info AS seatInfo, generate_time AS generateTime, check_time AS checkTime, expire_time AS expireTime, abnormal_reason AS abnormalReason FROM electronic_ticket WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY ticket_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE refund_record SET refund_status = #{targetStatus}, refund_time = CASE WHEN #{targetStatus} = 'REFUND_SUCCESS' THEN NOW() ELSE refund_time END, fail_reason = CASE WHEN #{targetStatus} = 'REFUND_FAILED' THEN #{failReason} ELSE NULL END, update_time = NOW() WHERE refund_id = #{refundId} AND refund_status = #{currentStatus}

UPDATE electronic_ticket SET ticket_status = 'EXPIRED', qr_code_value = NULL, check_time = NULL, expire_time = IFNULL(expire_time, NOW()), abnormal_reason = '退款成功，电子票已失效', refund_hold_status = NULL, refund_hold_abnormal_reason = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND ( ticket_status IN ('UNUSED', 'GENERATING', 'ERROR') OR (ticket_status = 'EXPIRED' AND refund_hold_status IS NOT NULL) )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM electronic_ticket WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND ticket_status = 'EXPIRED' AND refund_hold_status IN ('UNUSED', 'GENERATING', 'ERROR')
mapper.update: UPDATE electronic_ticket SET ticket_status = refund_hold_status, expire_time = NULL, abnormal_reason = refund_hold_abnormal_reason, refund_hold_status = NULL, refund_hold_abnormal_reason = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND ticket_status = 'EXPIRED' AND refund_hold_status IN ('UNUSED', 'GENERATING', 'ERROR')
